theme_archetype.reasoning: This app serves local vendors (Dhobis) and households in India. It needs to feel grounded, trustworthy, and highly accessible for users who may not be tech-savvy. The organic archetype avoids clinical 'tech' aesthetics and instead provides a warm, tactile, and calm interface.

typography.i18n_notes: Since the app supports English and Hindi, fonts must support Devanagari script gracefully. Manrope has excellent legibility for complex scripts.

brand_primary.usage: Headers, primary CTA backgrounds, active states. Represents trust, water, and cleanliness (Neel/Indigo).

brand_accent.usage: Alerts, pending payment badges, unreturned clothes notifications. High contrast.

color_palette.contrast_rules: All text must pass WCAG AA. Primary buttons must use white text on blue-900 background. Avoid generic blue; use deep indigo.

spacing_and_layout.container: w-full max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen bg-[#FAF9F6] relative shadow-2xl overflow-hidden
spacing_and_layout.generous_spacing: Use p-6 for main container padding, gap-4 or gap-6 for lists to ensure clear touch targets.
spacing_and_layout.touch_targets: Minimum height for interactive elements (buttons, inputs, list items) must be 48px (h-12).
spacing_and_layout.navigation: Use a sticky Bottom Navigation Bar with 3-4 distinct icons for mobile context, avoiding desktop-style sidebars.
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Left-align list items and forms. Center-align empty states and success messages.

surface_strategies.cards: The 'Tactile' Neumorphism variant: Flat white background, 1px subtle border (border-slate-100), soft shadow (shadow-sm). rounded-2xl.
surface_strategies.header: Solid or Crystal Glass (bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-slate-200) z-50 sticky top-0.
surface_strategies.bottom_nav: Solid white background, shadow-[0_-4px_20px_rgba(0,0,0,0.05)], rounded-t-3xl border-t border-slate-100.

component_rules.buttons: Rounded-xl or full pill shape. Active/hover states must visibly darken the color and add a slight transform (-translate-y-[1px]).
component_rules.inputs: Shadcn UI inputs with rounded-xl, h-12, bg-slate-50. Focus state: ring-2 ring-blue-900/20 border-blue-900.
component_rules.lists: Use prominent rows with left-aligned icon/avatar, center text content, and right-aligned action/price. Divide with border-b border-slate-100.
component_rules.badges: rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-medium. Paid: bg-green-100 text-green-800. Pending: bg-orange-100 text-orange-800.
component_rules.modals: Bottom sheet style Dialogs (rounded-t-3xl) instead of centered desktop modals, to match mobile UX.

motion_interactions.page_transitions: Slide in from right or fade in (duration-200 ease-out)
motion_interactions.list_stagger: Staggered fade-up for list items in the dashboard.

onboarding_hero.description: Used white and gray steam iron - for onboarding background or vendor profile header.
onboarding_hero.usage: Use as a background layer with a dark overlay (bg-black/40) for text legibility, or in an onboarding carousel.

empty_state_illustration.description: Neatly organized ironing board in bright minimalist room.
empty_state_illustration.usage: Use in 'No clothes given yet' or 'No active clients' empty states.

auth_background.description: Stack of freshly ironed clothes next to a steam iron.
auth_background.usage: Use at the top of the login/signup screen with a soft gradient fade into the #FAF9F6 background.

icons.strategy: Use stroke-width 1.5 or 2 for a clean, line-art look. Avoid solid filled icons unless representing active state in bottom nav.

testing_attributes.rule: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case, role-based format.

instructions_to_main_agent: This is a mobile app simulated in a web environment. Wrap the main application layout in a mobile container: <div className='w-full max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen bg-[#FAF9F6] relative shadow-2xl overflow-x-hidden'>
Use a bottom navigation bar layout instead of top/side nav. Fix it to the bottom of the max-w-md container.
Implement language toggle (English/Hindi) using standard React state or context, placed subtly in the profile or header section.
Since it's Indian currency, use the ₹ symbol explicitly for all rates and bills.
Use standard Shadcn components but heavily customize them with the soft utility theme: larger touch targets, rounded-xl/2xl, and the #FAF9F6/#1E3A8A color palette.
Implement the 3 main views: Auth (Phone Login), Iron Man Dashboard (Client List, Add Entry), and Client Dashboard (Clothes Status, Bill).
Do not use generic blue defaults. Replace with 'blue-900' for primary accents.
For the subscription paywall, create a dedicated full-screen view with a prominent CTA and clear value propositions.
